task: Review normalized project names, Unicode whitespace/lengths, duplicates and create/rename draft validation.

findings.summary: An interior soft hyphen, zero-width space, word joiner or BOM is accepted by the UI draft validator but rejected at the domain save boundary.
findings.reproduction: Paste Self\u{00AD}portrait as a create or rename draft. StudioDisplayName.newInput returns the name; ProjectLibrary.normalizedName throws invalidName. U+200B, U+2060, U+FEFF between visible words behave the same.
findings.evidence: Executed isolated Swift probe uses unchanged StudioDisplayName.swift and verbatim normalizedName method extracted from inspected source. UI=true/core=false for all four format-character cases.
findings.impact: Save is enabled for a draft that the command will reject, retaining the sheet and displaying an error. No saved/visible identity corruption or data loss was demonstrated; this is not classified as an M03 blocker.
findings.limits: Native SwiftUI interaction and Darwin Foundation were not executed; the UI consequence follows the reviewed canSubmit/submit path.

tests.result: Exit 0. NBSP/em-space/ideographic-space trimming agreed; 80 ASCII characters accepted, 81 rejected; Persian ZWNJ and joined-family emoji accepted identically; bidi override rejected identically; 320-scalar combining name accepted by both; 321 rejected only by intentionally stricter UI. Four interior format-character mismatches confirmed.
tests.platform: Swift 6.2.1 Linux; extracted normalization method, not compiled app

tests.result: Create, rename and duplicate all use normalizedName before mutation; IDs identify records independently of duplicate names. Row presentation retains original names, folds case/diacritics/width/default-ignorables for collisions, and adds distinguishing UUID prefixes across the full library. Rename requires a new draft when its legacy display is shortened. No material identity mismatch found in these paths.
Reviewed project-library invalid-name/round-trip tests and StudioDisplayName/ProjectLibraryPresentation Unicode, limit, duplicate/fallback/UUID-prefix tests; not executed.
No full suites, native/UI tests, project builds or source mutations.

outcome: No material saved/visible identity defect established. One confirmed limited UI/core validation mismatch reported to coordinator.
